Name: Acidic Exudation
Components: V, S, M (a pinch of saltpeter)
Description:
Your palm secretes a volatile gel, which you can use as a weapon.

For the duration, you can use a bonus action to throw a globule of the substance up to 30 feet. The globule explodes on impact, creating a shower of hissing acid in a 5-foot-radius sphere.

Creatures in the area must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 2d6 acid damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 2nd.
